fact: A tender for the procurement and implementation of an Education Management Information System and a Learning Management System, with maintenance support for 36 months, was published on Botswana's e-tender portal on 27 October 2025 and closed on 19 November 2025.
title: PROCUREMENT AND IMPLEMENTATION OF EDUCATION MANAGEMENT INFORMATION SYSTEM,LEARNING MANAGEMENT SYSTEM AND PERFECTION MAINTENANCE SUPPORT FOR 36 MONTHS
